title: Attio developer band
description: A dark developer band on a dashed blueprint grid (lines every 58px): on the left a hairline box holding a two-tone 40px heading and a small arrow button, on the right line art. On phones the heading centres over a short strip of grid with the art in it.
notes: forces the dark palette and marks itself data-header-tone="dark" for the attio header
the art is a media slot (435×348); empty, a grey placeholder box on the grid
